item.title: MakeMyTrip's India subsidiary receives Sebi approval to float IPO
item.description: Nasdaq-listed travel booking platform MakeMyTrip's India subsidiary has received Sebi's approval to launch an initial public offering (IPO), according to an update available on the markets regulator's website on Monday. MakeMyTrip (India) Ltd (MMT India) had filed draft papers with Sebi in July through the confidential route. After examining the draft documents, the regulator issued its final observations on November 6. Sebi's observations mark an important step in the IPO process, allowing the company to proceed with preparations for its public issues, subject to applicable regulatory requirements. The proposed IPO is expected to comprise a sale of equity shares in MMT India by its parent MakeMyTrip and its wholly-owned subsidiary, ibibo Group Holdings (Singapore) Pte Ltd, the Gurugram-headquartered company said in a regulatory filing with Nasdaq. item.description: Divi's Laboratories Ltd on Saturday posted a sharp 63.57 per cent rise in net profit to Rs 1,127 crore in the September quarter due to higher revenues. The company posted a net profit of Rs 689 crore in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year, a regulatory filing said. Revenue from operations rose 35.39 per cent to Rs 3,676 crore during the second quarter of FY27 from Rs 2,715 crore a year earlier, it said. item.title: Noel Tata to step down as Voltas chairman, appointed Chairman Emeritus
item.description: Noel N Tata, Chairman of Tata Trusts, has been appointed as Chairman Emeritus of Voltas, a day after he retired as Chairman and Director of the leading cooling products maker. Noel Tata will retire as Chairman and Director of Voltas Ltd on November 11, 2026, upon attaining the age of superannuation under Tata Group governance guidelines. Following his retirement, "the Board has appointed him as Chairman Emeritus of the Company with effect from November 12, 2026," said Voltas, a Tata Group firm, in its regulatory filing. The Companies Act 2013 mandates that any managing director or whole-time director cannot be appointed or continue employment if they are 70 years of age or older. Noel Tata, who was born on November 12, 1956, will turn 70 on November 12, 2026. He has been associated with Voltas since 2003.
